title: HeyGen pricing in 2026: every plan, credit and real cost

facts.quote: HeyGen has five tiers: **Free at $0**, **Creator at $29/month**, **Pro at $49/month**, **Business at $149/month**

facts.fact: HeyGen's Creator plan costs $29 per month.
HeyGen's Pro plan costs $49 per month.
HeyGen's Business plan costs $149 per month.
On HeyGen's Business plan, each extra seat costs $20 per month.
facts.quote: Extra seats on Business are $20 each per month.

facts.fact: HeyGen's Free plan allows 3 videos per month of up to 1 minute each, and exports carry a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 3 videos a month of up to 1 minute, with a watermark.

facts.fact: HeyGen's Creator plan includes 600 credits per month.
HeyGen's Pro plan includes 1,000 credits per month.
HeyGen's Business plan includes 1,500 credits per month.
HeyGen's Pro plan costs $20 more than its Creator plan and adds 400 extra credits.
facts.quote: Pro costs $20 more and adds 400 extra credits (1,000 vs 600)

facts.fact: Watermark removal on HeyGen starts on the Creator plan.
facts.quote: Watermark removal starts on the Creator plan at $29/month.

facts.fact: HeyGen's Free plan includes 1 custom video avatar.
HeyGen's Business plan includes 5 custom video avatars.
HeyGen prices its API separately from its subscription plans, so API usage is not covered by Creator, Pro or Business credits.
facts.quote: HeyGen prices its API separately from the subscription plans, so API usage is not covered by your Creator, Pro or Business credits.

facts.fact: HeyGen's prices are in USD, were taken from heygen.com in September 2026, and HeyGen can change plans and regional pricing at any time.
facts.quote: Prices in USD, taken from heygen.com in September 2026. HeyGen can change plans and regional pricing at any time

facts.fact: According to Vuela.ai, all Vuela.ai plans are cancel-anytime with no lock-in contracts.
facts.quote: All Vuela.ai plans are cancel-anytime with no lock-in contracts.

facts.fact: Vuela.ai states it offers 70+ AI tools for video, image, and text creation under one plan.
facts.quote: 70+ AI tools for video, image, and text creation under one plan.
